title: Detroit Golf Club

blurb: Since 1899, our history has been immersed in the tradition of the game and the fabric of Detroit. Our Clubhouse, designed by Albert Kahn in 1916, continues to welcome a wide cross-section of individuals and families, business leaders, and friends of the game. From the moment Members drive up to this hidden gem, they’re met with a beautiful setting and a broad range of activities for all ages.
